services.name: Formosan termite protection
services.blurb: A yearly plan built for Formosan termites, which swarm here every May and nest inside walls.

services.name: Termite inspection
services.blurb: Piers, sills, door frames and attic checked on raised and slab houses, with a written report.

services.name: Termite treatment
services.blurb: Liquid or bait chosen for your house type, explained with sample prices for each.

services.name: Wood damage check
services.blurb: Soft sills, door frames and floor joists probed and photographed so you can show your carpenter.

services.name: Roaches
services.blurb: Big outdoor roaches kept out with sealing and an outside treatment; we tell you what and where first.

services.name: Mosquito yard treatment
services.blurb: Courtyards, side alleys and planters treated monthly through the long, humid season.

services.name: Roof rats
services.blurb: Rats in the attic trapped and the gaps under the eaves sealed so they cannot come back.

services.name: Ants
services.blurb: Kitchen and bathroom ant trails followed outside to the nest and treated there.

services.name: Swarm-season visit
services.blurb: A May evening check of your lights, windows and eaves during swarm season, with what to do next.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Mother's Day weekend the swarmers covered the porch light on our shotgun in the Bywater. Celeste told us to kill the lights, then came Monday and found them in a door frame.
reviews.name: Lucien P.

reviews.text: Our camelback is raised on piers. She went under with a flashlight and a probe, took pictures of two soft sill spots, and marked them on a sketch of the house.
reviews.name: Tamika G.

reviews.text: We were buying a Creole cottage in the Marigny and wanted to know what we were getting. The wood damage check gave our carpenter exact spots to look at.
reviews.name: Sean K.

reviews.text: Slab house in Metairie. She explained why bait made more sense for us than liquid and showed both prices. Stations checked every quarter since.
reviews.name: Joanne B.

reviews.text: Rats running in the attic over the kitchen. She found the gap where the gutter meets the eave, sealed it, and the traps did the rest in a week.
reviews.name: Mike A.

reviews.text: The courtyard was unusable by June. Monthly mosquito treatment and we had people over for the Fourth without anyone slapping their legs all night.
reviews.name: Rachel O.

proof.guarantee: If Formosans show up in a treated area while your plan is active, we treat again at no charge.
